[[A Second Profession]] | experience reward = 500 | completion reward = {{skill icon|Healing Breeze}}, {{skill icon|Banish}} }} Show you have the makings of a [[monk]] by rescuing a [[Gwen|young girl]] from the [[skale]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | profession = monk | primary = y | test = n }} ===Objectives=== * Go southwest up the road until you find [[skale]]. Cross the river and find the missing girl [[Gwen]]. * Lead Gwen back to [[Ciglo the Monk]]. Gwen will not move as long as the skale are in the way. ===Reward=== * 500 [[Experience]] * 25 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) * {{skill icon|Healing Breeze}} * {{skill icon|Banish}} ==Walkthrough== Cross the river away from [[Ciglo the Monk]] and find Gwen. Once you find her, kill the three [[River Skale Tad]] that are in the river near her. Once you kill the [[Skale]], lead her back towards Ciglo the Monk and talk to him to receive your reward. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Skale]] *{{e}} 0 [[River Skale Tad]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Ciglo the Monk :''"There's a little girl named '''Gwen''' who I'm worried about. She seems to have wandered across the river, and I'm sure she won't make it back through all those '''skale''' without some help. Please go lead her back here safely."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'll go and get her. | decline = Wait, I don't think I'm ready. | ask = Please don't waste time. Go down to the river and bring '''Gwen''' back. The skale should be relatively easy to overcome. I have faith in you. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== ;Gwen :''"Help me! Those monsters in the river are trying to eat me!"'' '''Gwen:''' ''"Thanks for killing the monsters! I'll follow you back to the gate."'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Ciglo the Monk :''"Gwen looks unharmed. That is good enough for me. I believe you can be entrusted with a few skills. May these skills aid you as you seek to bring peace and harmony to the people of [[Ascalon]]."'' :''"I will return to the city and inform [[Sir Tydus]] of your actions here.
